verdict.rationale: The evidence describes checkout requiring a 'payment credential' collected before completion, negotiated payment_handlers (e.g., Google Pay), and AP2-style cryptographic payment mandates — but nothing describes a user-funded wallet the agent holds/spends from, nor any balance-visibility feature for that wallet. This is a fair axis for an agentic-commerce platform (payment-credentials theme) but no evidence shows Shopify provisions such a wallet.
